name: @edam/anchoring
description: External anchoring (Sprint-2 / EDAM-T130): AnchorProvider abstraction over the frozen {rfc3161, transparency_log, dual_custodian} enum. The provider receives only the hash of the signed anchor payload (no plaintext); ANCHORED only after a verified external token; no fabrication on failure. Interface + dev fake only this task — no real TSA, no state machine, no WORM.
